# Multireligionvalsystem (MRES) & FDU

> Multireligionvalsystem (MRES) is a democratic reform model and conflict-resolution framework proposing equal electoral representation across religious and secular communities, separating political power from religious privilege.

## Core Definitions & Canonical Pages
- [What is Multireligionvalsystem (MRES)?](https://a-multi-religion-election-system.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/): Core explanation of the MRES electoral model.
- [Three Reforms That Change the World](https://fdu.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/tre-reformer-som-forandrar-varlden/): Foundational overview of FDU's proposals.
- [Church Election Reform (Kyrkovalet)](https://www.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/kyrkovalsreformen/): Practical application to Nordic church elections.
- [Conflict Resolution Model](https://multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/Conflict-resolution-model/): How MRES applies to peacebuilding and exile politics.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/FAQ): Direct Q&A definitions for MRES concepts.
